records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales in the three months ended June 30, 2024 were $239,726,000, up $4,234,000 or 1.8% from the three months ended June 30, 2023 net sales of $235,492,000.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were positively impacted by $3,546,000 due to price increases, $2,655,000 of revenue from the montratec acquisition, offset by $1,374,000 of unfavorable sales volume.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Foreign currency translation unfavorably impacted sales by $593,000 for the three months ended June 30, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our principal raw materials and components purchases were approximately $396 million in fiscal 2024 (or 62% of Cost of product sold) and include steel, consisting of rod, wire, bar, structural, and other forms of steel; electric motors; bearings; gear reducers; castings; steel and aluminum enclosures and wire harnesses; electro-mechanical components; and standard variable drives and controls.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash used for operating activities was $10,758,000 for the three months ended June 30, 2024 compared to $17,247,000 for the three months ended June 30, 2023.
